endorsements.name: Jon Cagan
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-0554
endorsements.description: The Podlove Podcast Publisher plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the Feed Name value in version <= 4.1.25 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with administrator-level access, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This only affects multi-site installations and installations where unfiltered_html has been disabled.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 4.4)

povs-taxonomy.explanation: The CVE endorsement credits this individual with a reviewed vulnerability finding.

endorsements.name: Jon Cagan
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-3427
endorsements.description: The 3DPrint Lite plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to SQL Injection via the 'infill_text' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.1.3.6 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query.  This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 4.9)
